ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Canara Bank reported a robust Q2 FY27, significantly surpassing most guidance targets with strong global advances growth of 19.46% YoY, alongside excellent asset quality improvement, achieving Gross NPA of 1.33% and Net NPA of 0.30%. The bank strategically improved its cost of funds by replacing higher-cost bulk deposits with FCNR(B) funds; however, a substantial ₹600 crore P&L loss from FVTPL treasury operations due to hardening yields and the lower spread on FCNR(B) are expected to temper Net Interest Margin (NIM) going forward.
